title: Grounding Agent Memory: Environment-Probing Curation for Enterprise Agents
title_zh: 扎根智能体记忆：面向企业智能体的环境探测式整理
abstract_en: Persistent memory is entering production-oriented agent platforms to help long-horizon agents accumulate experience across sessions. Yet a post-task curator agent restricted to completed trajectories can preserve errors, overgeneralize partial evidence, or retain stale knowledge. We introduce environment-probing curation, a deployment-compatible extension that gives an existing asynchronous curator agent least-privilege, read-only world tools to check, scope, and refresh candidate memories. It requires no model retraining and leaves the task agent, retriever, memory representation, and production write authority unchanged. In a production-like GitHub Copilot (GHCP) harness built on its SDK, we compare stateless execution, full in-context learning, GHCP + Mem, and GHCP + Mem (w/ Env Probing) on CLBench database exploration and 90 adapted APEX management-consulting tasks. On CLBench, probing raises pass rate from 39% to 73% and pass-discounted reward from 8.60 to 22.60 while reducing queries from 8.8 to 4.7 per question and task-agent cost from \$3.38 to \$1.68. Across six APEX worlds, all 18 memory-versus-baseline mean reward comparisons are positive and task-agent tool calls fall by 16--75%; probing gives the best task-agent reward gain per dollar in five worlds. Probing also attains higher mean reward than GHCP + Mem on both Sonnet 4.6 and Opus 4.7 without schema drift. Environment probing therefore turns existing agent-memory curation into an environment-informed, auditable process while preserving a compact task-time interface.
abstract_zh: 持久化记忆可帮助长时程智能体跨会话积累经验，但仅依据已完成轨迹工作的事后整理器可能保留错误、过度泛化局部证据或存储过时知识。本文提出环境探测式整理（environment-probing curation）：为现有异步整理器提供最小权限、只读的环境工具，用于核验、限定范围并刷新候选记忆。该方法无需重新训练模型，也不改变任务智能体、检索器、记忆表示或生产写入权限。在基于 GitHub Copilot（GHCP）SDK 的生产近似测试环境中，作者比较了无状态执行、完整上下文学习、GHCP + Mem 和 GHCP + Mem（w/ Env Probing）。在 CLBench 数据库探索任务上，环境探测将通过率从 39% 提升至 73%，折算通过奖励从 8.60 提升至 22.60，同时将每题查询次数从 8.8 降至 4.7，任务智能体成本从 3.38 美元降至 1.68 美元。在六个 APEX 管理咨询任务环境中，记忆方案相较基线的 18 组平均奖励比较全部为正，任务智能体工具调用减少 16%—75%；环境探测在五个环境中实现了最佳的单位成本任务奖励增益。在 Sonnet 4.6 和 Opus 4.7 上，环境探测的平均奖励均高于 GHCP + Mem，且未出现 schema drift。结果表明，环境探测能将智能体记忆整理转化为受环境信息约束、可审计的过程，同时保持紧凑的任务时接口。
key_points_zh: 提出 environment-probing curation，让异步记忆整理器通过最小权限、只读环境工具核验和刷新候选记忆。
方法无需模型再训练，不改变任务智能体、retriever、memory representation 或生产写入权限，便于部署到现有企业智能体平台。
在 CLBench 上通过率由 39% 提升至 73%，任务智能体成本降低约 50%，查询次数几乎减半。
在六个 APEX 环境中，记忆方案均优于无记忆基线；环境探测在五个环境中取得最佳的单位成本奖励增益。
在 Sonnet 4.6 与 Opus 4.7 上均优于 GHCP + Mem，且保持 schema 稳定，体现出较好的可审计性与泛化能力。

llm_assessment.comment: This work makes persistent memory curation environment-grounded and auditable, directly addressing stale, erroneous, and overgeneralized agent memories with a reusable deployment-compatible mechanism.
llm_assessment.comment_zh: 该工作通过可复用且兼容部署的环境探测机制，使持久记忆整理具备事实依据和可审计性，并直接缓解陈旧、错误及过度泛化的智能体记忆。
